tvShow.name: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon
tvShow.originalName: 自動販売機に生まれ変わった俺は迷宮を彷徨う
tvShow.overview: A middle-aged man with only one passion in his life meets a fitting end in a traffic accident. That's where most stories would end, but instead, this is when his story begins when he's reborn as what he admired the most in life--a vending machine! But his new lease on life happens in the worst place possible--what can a vending machine do in a monster-infested dungeon when he can't speak or even move on his own?

episodes.name: The Vending Machine Travels
episodes.overview: After his untimely death, our unlikely hero finds himself in another world, reincarnated as a vending machine. Now his life revolves around selling things to people, but he's stuck in the middle of nowhere with no sign of any customers.

episodes.name: The King Frog Fiend Appears
episodes.overview: The Hunters Association hires Lammis and Boxxo to provide food during a frog fiend hunt, with a ragtag group acting as their bodyguards. But things turn ominous when the fiends prove to be more numerous than expected.

episodes.name: Rebuilding
episodes.overview: The expedition returns to find the village has been attacked, but fortunately the damage is limited. Boxxo and Lammis discover they both have plenty of ways to help during the recovery effort.

episodes.name: Boxxo Is Abducted
episodes.overview: A gang of thieves carts Boxxo away so they can extract his money, but the real surprise turns out to be the individual who's supposed to figure out how to pull off the theft.

episodes.name: Vanity, Pride, and Vending Machine
episodes.overview: Boxxo is already well known throughout the village for the items he's sold to date, and now he begins to find new ways to assist various residents with their problems.

episodes.name: The Fighting Vending Machine
episodes.overview: Boxxo falls into a new stratum, and there he has an unexpected encounter with some hungry hunters who think he's nothing more than a convenient magic item.

episodes.name: The Voracious Devils
episodes.overview: Boxxo falls into a new stratum, and there he has an unexpected encounter with some hungry hunters who think he's nothing more than a convenient magic item.

episodes.name: The Flame Skeletitan of the Labyrinth Stratum
episodes.overview: Boxxo, Lammis, and a large formidable group go on a campaign in the Labyrinth stratum to defeat the local stratum lord. Meanwhile, Kerioyl reveals his reasons for targeting such foes in the first place.

episodes.name: A Less-Than-Ideal Hero
episodes.overview: Director Bear commissions Boxxo, Lammis, Hulemy, and the Band of Gluttons to survey the exterior of the labyrinth. Joining them is a powerful hunter who has more going on than meets the eye.

episodes.name: Gastric Measures
episodes.overview: Munami and the Restaurant Union decide to hold an eating contest, but that's a risky venture given the appetites of some of the locals. Can Boxxo save the day once again?

episodes.name: The Dead's Lament Stratum
episodes.overview: Captain Kerioyl wants a group to explore the Dead's Lament stratum and eventually defeat its stratum lord, but there's a big problem. Lammis can't cope with the scary monsters inhabiting the place!

episodes.name: What Can Be Done as a Vending Machine
episodes.overview: Boxxo and friends track down the King of Souls stratum lord and launch an attack on him. But they face their greatest trial yet when the plan goes badly off the rails.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview:
A man with a passion for vending machines awakens to realize that he has not only died, but he has also been reborn as one of his beloved machines! Although he is a modern appliance in a fantasy world, he requires money in order to keep functioning. He is stuck in one location until a young girl named Lammis stumbles upon him. Amazed by the drinks and food he sells, Lammis uses her "Blessing of Might" to lift him with ease and take him back to the village of Clearflow Lake. There, she officially dubs him Boxxo.

Despite his inability to converse with the villagers, Boxxo becomes an essential part of the community. His goods provide nourishment, and, as he gains new abilities and products, he becomes a staple of daily life. Nobody is as loyal to Boxxo as his first and best customer, Lammis. The more time he spends with her, the more he tries to help her elevate her skills as a young hunter.

episodes.name: Hunters and Motives
episodes.overview: A large group of ace hunters gather to the Dead's Lament stratum to take down the Netherlord once and for all.

episodes.name: Mutual Understanding
episodes.overview: Boxxo and crew have to defend what's left of the Clearflow Lake stratum's village against a horde of monsters.

episodes.name: Strong Feelings
episodes.overview: To get rid of the monsters in Clearflow Lake stratum, first the hole in the defensive wall needs to be filled.

episodes.name: The Clergyman and the Vending Machine
episodes.overview: A small group including Boxxo goes to the Origin stratum to help fight off the attacking monster horde there.

episodes.name: Respective Wishes
episodes.overview: In order to securely evacuate the Origin stratum, the enemy commander must first be found and neutralized.

episodes.name: Sweet Temptation
episodes.overview: Kerioyl reveals many surprises when Boxxo and friends pay their first visit to the Menagerie of Fools' base.

episodes.name: The Animals and the Girl
episodes.overview: While searching for magic stones, Boxxo and Director Bear stumble upon an unusual trio inside the labyrinth.

episodes.name: The Dark Forest Stratum
episodes.overview: Boxxo and friends end up in the Dark Forest stratum, where they must help the locals with some problems.

episodes.name: Conflagration
episodes.overview: The lord of the Dark Forest stratum needs to be defeated, but nothing seems to provoke it into attacking.

episodes.name: The Dungeon Goddess Grand Prix
episodes.overview: To help boost morale, Munami holds a popularity contest amongst the ladies living in Clearflow Lake stratum.

episodes.name: Into the Scorching Desert
episodes.overview: When Hevee departs for the Scorching Sand stratum to deal with a personal matter, the other heroes follow him.

episodes.name: Blizzard in the Desert
episodes.overview: While Hevee sorts out his unfinished business with Tashtay, some unexpected foes arrive to complicate matters.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview:
Ever since a vending machine enthusiast was reincarnated as one named Boxxo, he has become a pivotal part of the village of Clearflow Lake. With his ability to turn into any kind of vending machine and serve a variety of products, Boxxo has helped the settlement grow and has fought various formidable enemies alongside his first and most loyal customer, Lammis.

However, Boxxo and Lammis' recent battle with the Netherlord, a general serving under the Demon Lord, has left the future uncertain. To take action against the looming threat, the directors of each Hunter Association agree to strike back by dispatching their best hunters. Joined by friends old and new, Boxxo and Lammis must thwart the Netherlord's evil plans by any means necessary to protect all that they cherish.

episodes.name: Each to Their Own Story
episodes.overview: Boxxo and Kikoyu celebrate birthdays, and the party ventures to the Dog Mountain stratum.

episodes.name: The Clam and the Vending Machine
episodes.overview: Boxxo's crew reach Pity's island, where old and new enemies await them.

episodes.name: A Stay in Enemy Territory
episodes.overview: Boxxo and Pity seek a way to escape from the Netherlord's base.

episodes.name: The Troubles Will Continue Forever
episodes.overview: The situation gets hairy at the Dog Mountain stratum, and Boxxo attempts to help Gorth with his love life.

episodes.name: Another Uproar
episodes.overview: Plans to tackle the Everlasting stratum are put on hold when a large horde of monsters attacks the village.

episodes.name: Yesterday's Enemies Are Today's...
episodes.overview: The path through the Everlasting stratum is long, dark, and monotonous, but that doesn't rule out surprises.

episodes.name: The Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: Boxxo and friends learn some unexpected dungeon lore in the innermost depths of the Everlasting stratum.

episodes.name: As an Apprentice
episodes.overview: With the dungeon collapsed and Boxxo gone, the rest of the heroes split up to go salvage the situation.

episodes.name: The Thumb General
episodes.overview: Boxxo returns, but his group has a fight on their hands before they can catch up to everyone else.

episodes.name: I Am a Field without Equal
episodes.overview: Field goes to parley with the Demon Lord, and plans for countering the Netherlord begin to take shape.

episodes.name: To the Final Showdown
episodes.overview: Boxxo and Lammis face betrayal below as the Netherlord ignites the final battle.

episodes.name: Dreamworld
episodes.overview: Boxxo has to use every trick in the book to fight the mighty Netherlord. Can he and Lammis save the world?

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview:
Boxxo and Lammis venture into the labyrinth’s uncharted lower levels, where the trials grow harsher and the enemies more cunning. In the aftermath of the Netherworld conflict, they must uncover the true ambitions of the Menagerie of Fools and protect the settlement’s inhabitants from a looming threat capable of disrupting the balance of power across the world.

As Boxxo’s abilities reach new heights, he unlocks increasingly advanced transformations to defend his allies and support them in prolonged battles. At the same time, his long-held desire to regain his human form takes center stage, as the resources he has gathered finally bring him closer to uncovering the mystery behind his reincarnation in this magical world.
